Scope: only quality check 13. Read the actual frozen XLSX using openpyxl: Quality Checks row 14 defines shipped inputs existing at expected paths and matching prompt, solution and judge assumptions; Internal Quality Checks row 14 agrees. Deterministic Checks rows 4, 9 and 12 define referenced assets, actual Docker COPY/ADD sources and parsable fixtures. Compared every sheet's cell values against the skill-bundled workbook; they match. Applied frozen references/quality-checks.md:58-60 and deterministic-checks.md Docker/fixture procedures manually, not as a private checker run.

All task-relative citations below refer to .qc-cache/coldwater-2026-09-30-hardening/task/. instruction.md:5 says 'read the six notes in /instructions' and '/assets/seed_data.json describes the starting scope'; instruction.md:9 names /instructions/integration.md. Actual environment/instructions contains exactly six nonempty files: overview.md, behaviour.md, ui.md, integration.md, security.md and policy.md. Read each in full. Recursive references from these notes resolve to integration.md, behaviour.md and security.md. A read-only inventory comparison using exact POSIX names found zero missing paths; terminal prose punctuation was removed before comparing. environment/assets contains only seed_data.json, which parses as JSON and has product='Colderwater Playground', snippets=[], and an explicit note that no implementation or starter files are supplied (seed_data.json:2-4).

environment/Dockerfile:14-16 has 'COPY instructions/ /instructions/', 'COPY assets/ /assets/' and 'chmod -R a+rX /instructions /assets'. Both COPY sources exist and contain all seven supplied files. Neither task-root nor environment/.dockerignore exists to exclude them. These are the only active agent-image COPY/ADD directives. No solution or tests files are copied into the agent image. task.toml:2 includes '/assets' among artifacts. This is source-based image-content verification; no new Docker build was run.

Seed content agrees with instruction.md:5 ('There isn't a starter app to finish'), environment/instructions/overview.md:9 (examples come with the completed app separately from saved records), integration.md:9 ('It contains no user snippets or implementation'; delivered runtime cannot depend on /assets or /instructions), policy.md:7, tests/app_context.md:8 and :24, and gates/render/judge.toml:23 ('An empty saved library is valid'). The golden's server creates an empty snippets table rather than expecting hidden seeded records (solution/app/server.js:113-128). It serves its own /starters directory and public assets (server.js:100-102). solve.sh:7 checks its hello.js exists and :26 copies the entire solution/app tree to /app. All five examples enumerated by solution/app/src/app.tsx:7 exist: hello.js, counter.html, sheet.css, broken.js and slow.js. Read those files and both starter notes; deliberately failing broken.js/slow.js are labelled examples of error/timeout handling, not missing required inputs. app.tsx:56 loads the packaged examples and :144 automatically selects hello.js when no saved record exists. Both public/index.html assets (/assets/index-VduTT3aN.js and /assets/index-C_1hOHr1.css) exist under solution/app/public/assets; these are browser URLs served from /app/public, not dependencies on the environment /assets directory. /runner.html referenced by src/runtime.ts:185 exists under public/.

Judge fixture assumptions were cross-checked across all tests/*.md and *.toml files for assets, seed, examples and library references. No judge names hello.js/counter.html/sheet.css/broken.js/slow.js as mandatory participant fixtures. Functional prompt S01 at tests/scored/functional/prompt.md:119-121 accepts startup from an app example or saved snippet, says not to demand an empty library, and explicitly requires no particular example names, source language, picker layout or save-dialog design. Its criteria at functional/judge.toml:29, :36 and :43 score useful startup, a working editable example, and separation of built-ins from user records. Gates/constraints/judge.toml:27-29 creates its own record and rejects substituting an existing example as persistence proof. The app context and scored prompts accommodate gate-created records; no exact initial library count is assumed.

Independent read-only verification of raw qc/runs/coldwater-2026-09-30-hardening/golden/run-golden-20260930-070504/RESULTS.json found all 22 actual_app_files SHA256 values equal the current frozen solution/app bytes. In facts.S01.startup_ready.evidence.value the entered source is the actual hello.js file, preview contains '12 squared is 144', console contains 'printed %d rows' and '12', and manual_run_used=false. facts.S01.usable_examples records the same example followed by authored source yielding 'example-authored-marker' in both preview and console. Recomputed the facts.S01.example_separate equalities: original==builtin, loaded==expected, server.code==expected.code, and builtin.code differs from the saved edited record; all true. Inspected the executed drivers/workspace_flow.cjs:43-89 to establish how those fields were observed. This corroborates packaged asset usability only; scripted browser evidence is not a full configured judge run, Docker-image build measurement, Oracle score or target-model score.

Counterexample attempts: a conforming alternative with differently named built-in examples, an empty initial saved library and no runtime read of /assets/seed_data.json is permitted by the explicit instructions and S01 rather than falsely failed. A broken candidate missing seed_data.json or omitting COPY assets/ was simulated solely by removing entries from the read-only inventory/checker's in-memory sets: each correctly reported /assets/seed_data.json missing. Removing security.md similarly reported /instructions/security.md. No task bytes were mutated and no current false-pass/false-fail witness was found for this asset row.
